decision.overall_recommendation: VIX gate is open, so new entries are permissible, but this system's own track record is weak right now (60 sample picks, 13.3% win rate, avg return -2.63%, and even rank-1 picks only won 20% of the time) — conviction and position sizing should stay conservative regardless of how clean this run's setups look. 8 of 32 candidates (RMBS, ENPH, ALB, INOD, GMED, MDU, PFGC, TNL) were excluded as still-falling knives despite otherwise-clean technicals, and CAR/CC/BKD/ECHO were excluded for deteriorating fundamentals or negative catalysts. Favor the confirmed-support, better-fundamental names near the top of the list (CRUS, PTCT, LBRT, TPR) and size the 'forming'-support, higher-beta names (USAR, WULF, CLSK) smaller. Note CRUS adds to an already-dominant existing Technology concentration (INTC is ~60% of the current book), so weight it accordingly. No open orders conflict with any of these tickers.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Cirrus Logic has beaten EPS estimates in all 8 of its last reported quarters, a remarkably consistent record, though growth decelerated sharply last quarter (revenue +2.5%, EPS -5.6%) after a blowout prior quarter. News is routine market commentary with no CRUS-specific catalyst; A+ rating and Buy consensus support the fundamental picture.
ranked_picks.rationale: Confirmed higher low (+3.05%), contracting range and a falling down/up volume ratio support stabilization near value area; combined with a spotless beat record and top analyst score, this is the strongest fundamental+technical match in the batch despite no fresh news catalyst.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Growth clearly decelerated last quarter and there's no concrete near-term catalyst in the news to sustain momentum beyond the technical bounce — this is largely a mean-reversion trade dependent on the semiconductor cycle staying favorable.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: PTC Therapeutics beat EPS estimates in 3 of its last 4 quarters (including 0.92 vs 0.24 est last quarter), and just announced a $111M upfront acquisition of Sangamo's ST-920 Fabry program with an FDA filing expected in Q4 2026 — a genuine forward catalyst. Analysts raised targets recently (+5.6%) with a Buy-leaning consensus.
ranked_picks.rationale: Confirmed higher low, contracting range, and falling down/up volume all support stabilization; the named FDA filing timeline gives this pick a concrete forward catalyst most others in this batch lack, and analysts are revising targets up.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Biotech EPS here is extremely lumpy, the prior quarter was a large miss, and the trade's reward:risk is thin (1.47, flagged WeakRR) — a disappointing Fabry-program update or FDA filing delay could quickly erase the technical edge.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Liberty Energy beat estimates in 3 of its last 4 quarters, with earnings turning solidly positive after a stretch of losses, and its SLB data-center power/infrastructure alliance is a real diversification catalyst beyond core frac services. Latest quarter showed +16% revenue and +91% net income growth.
ranked_picks.rationale: Strong confirmed reversal signal — an +8.2% higher low and already-positive Last10d/Last20d returns, plus a sane 3.35 reward:risk, make this one of the cleaner combinations, helped by the SLB-driven data-center power narrative.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Price sits 13% above its point of control, meaning thinner volume support underneath if the bounce fails, and Liberty remains a leveraged oilfield-services name exposed to commodity/rig-count swings the technical pattern doesn't independently confirm.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Tapestry beat EPS estimates in all 4 of its last reported quarters, but its latest print paired a beat with a softer FY27 sales outlook (Kate Spade recovery 'taking longer'), which pressured the stock despite the beat-and-raise headline.
ranked_picks.rationale: Confirmed higher low, contracting range and falling down/up volume, plus a strong beat record and a large gap to average analyst target, support inclusion despite the softer guidance headline.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Management itself flagged a slower Kate Spade turnaround and softer FY27 guidance, and revenue growth has been erratic quarter to quarter (-23% one quarter, +47% the next) — the market's reaction to guidance, not the beat, is the real swing factor.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: DT Midstream's last two quarters were a narrow miss and a beat, with revenue growth positive but net income growth negative last quarter (-13.8%); analysts trimmed the average target -8.5% recently (on thin, single-analyst coverage) even as a fresh analyst upgrade appeared in this week's news.
ranked_picks.rationale: Confirmed stabilization (positive higher low, contracting range, falling down/up volume, already-positive Last10d return) combined with a sane 5:1 reward:risk make this a reasonably clean pullback-reversal candidate.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Earnings have been mixed with a recent miss, and the recent target cut — even on thin coverage — is a real signal that the sell-side isn't uniformly bullish right now.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Regency Centers beat EPS estimates in all 4 of its last reported quarters, including a large Q4 2025 beat, though net income growth has swung sharply quarter to quarter. No News items were returned for this ticker, so there is no specific fresh catalyst to point to.
ranked_picks.rationale: Confirmed technical stabilization, low beta (0.81), and decent analyst upside to an $88.50 average target, paired with a clean beat record, make this a lower-volatility complement to the more speculative names in this batch.
ranked_picks.bear_case: There is no material catalyst behind this pick at all, and the pullback is shallow (-1.5% vs EMA200) — upside depends entirely on the pattern playing out with no news tailwind to help it along.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: First Hawaiian beat EPS estimates in each of its last 4 quarters, and just announced it is acquiring TriCo Bancshares in an all-stock deal — a real strategic expansion catalyst, though the reported -61% revenue growth last quarter looks like a bank-accounting anomaly worth treating cautiously. Consensus is Hold-leaning (4 buy/10 hold/4 sell).
ranked_picks.rationale: Confirmed higher low and consistent beats support inclusion, and the TriCo acquisition is a concrete strategic catalyst, though it's an announced deal rather than an imminent event.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The sell-side split (more holds/sells than buys) is more cautious than the beat record alone suggests, and TriCo acquisition-integration risk could weigh on shares even if the deal is strategically sound.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: The New York Times beat or met EPS estimates in each of its last 4 quarters, and the stock is already up 5.8% over the last 20 days — a shallower, already-recovering pullback (-5.1% vs EMA200) rather than a deep one. No NYT-specific catalyst appears in the News.
ranked_picks.rationale: Strongly confirmed support (a +5.3% higher low and already-positive 10/20-day returns) and a clean beat record support inclusion, though reward:risk is on the weak side given the position is less oversold than others here.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Much of the easy reward may already be behind this trade since price already reversed, and the analyst base is Hold-leaning (11 hold vs 5 buy) rather than strongly bullish.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Ormat beat or met EPS estimates in each of its last 4 quarters, but revenue and net income growth both fell sharply last quarter (-36%/-39%), a concerning deceleration despite the EPS beat. An analyst just turned less bearish, but overall consensus remains Hold with a mediocre quality score.
ranked_picks.rationale: Confirmed higher low and reasonable range contraction support the technical case, and a recent analyst upgrade is a mild tailwind, but this ranks below cleaner names given the sharp growth deceleration.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The steep drop in revenue/net-income growth last quarter is a real fundamental warning sign the EPS beat doesn't fully offset, reflected in a Hold rating and weak overall analyst score (2/5).

ranked_picks.research_highlight: CenterPoint Energy beat or met EPS estimates in each of its last 4 quarters, but revenue and net income growth declined sharply last quarter (-27.7%/-22.8%), and analysts trimmed the average target -6.5% recently on thin coverage. No CNP-specific catalyst in the News.
ranked_picks.rationale: Confirmed stabilization and a consistent beat record support inclusion, but sharp growth deceleration and a Hold-rated consensus keep this lower, with reward:risk (2.48) on the weak side.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Revenue and net income growth both declined meaningfully last quarter despite the EPS beat, and the recent negative target revision — even on thin coverage — suggests some analyst caution creeping in.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: People Incorporated (formerly IAC, renamed June 2026) has extremely noisy quarterly results tied to ongoing restructuring/spinoff activity, making the beat/miss pattern hard to interpret cleanly; the only recent News item is a routine earnings-call transcript with no material catalyst.
ranked_picks.rationale: Technical stabilization is confirmed (positive higher low, falling down/up volume ratio, sane 5:1 reward:risk), but the fundamental picture is clouded by recent corporate restructuring, so this ranks in the middle of the list.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The recent name change and structural reorganization make the reported EPS/revenue trend genuinely hard to trust as a clean read on the underlying business, and there is no fresh catalyst to lean on.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: AAON beat EPS estimates in 3 of its last 4 quarters with strong revenue/EPS growth (26%/41% last quarter), but the News explicitly notes analysts slashed price targets to $135/$125 immediately after the last beat — a real headwind despite the strong beat-and-raise headline.
ranked_picks.rationale: Support is only 'forming' — the pullback low was made just 1 day ago with no confirmed higher low yet, so despite strong fundamentals, the technical stabilization case is weaker than the confirmed names ranked above it.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Analysts specifically cut price targets right after the last earnings beat, a real valuation-concern signal, and the lack of a confirmed higher low means the pullback could still have room to run.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: YETI beat EPS estimates in each of its last 4 quarters and analysts raised both targets (+1.8%) and forecasts after Q2 even though sales missed. Growth was strong overall (Q2 revenue +27%, net income +624%), though one quarter showed a sharp revenue decline.
ranked_picks.rationale: Support is only 'forming' — a positive higher low and contracting range are present, but Last10d return (-6.8%) is still meaningfully negative, so stabilization isn't fully confirmed; the beat record and positive target revisions are the main draw.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Reward:risk here is weak (1.6, flagged WeakRR) and the stock is still down nearly 7% over 10 days, so there's real risk the pullback isn't finished even with intact fundamentals.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: USA Rare Earth missed on both revenue and EPS last quarter, but the broader story is catalyst-rich: a completed combination with Serra Verde, a $1.55B government-backed offtake milestone, and continued federal rare-earth funding tailwinds. This is an early-stage, low-revenue company where growth metrics remain noisy.
ranked_picks.rationale: A positive higher low (+1.8%) and 11 days since the pullback low show some base-building, but Last10d return (-8.6%) is still notably negative, so this is 'forming' rather than confirmed; the real draw is the sector tailwind and M&A/funding catalysts, not the earnings record.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The company just missed on both top and bottom lines, remains pre-scale with thin analyst coverage (1 target), and carries very high beta (2.6) — the recent news is genuinely positive but the earnings trend hasn't caught up.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Brixmor beat EPS estimates in 3 of its last 4 quarters, and analysts raised forecasts after Q2 results, but net income growth swung to -42% last quarter despite the beat. No major negative news, and target-revision trend is modestly positive medium-term (+12.4%).
ranked_picks.rationale: Support shows partial confirmation — a positive higher low and falling down/up volume ratio, but the 5-day range is still wider than the prior 15-day range (1.32), so full stabilization isn't confirmed; the post-Q2 analyst forecast raise is a genuine positive.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Net income growth fell sharply last quarter despite the EPS beat, and reward:risk is weak (1.92, flagged WeakRR), making the edge thinner than the top-ranked names.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: TeraWulf missed EPS estimates badly and consistently in all 8 of its last reported quarters, but the business is transforming into AI/data-center infrastructure with real, large contracts (a $19B, 20-year Anthropic lease; FERC-approved Morgantown Power acquisition) driving strong revenue growth (+31.6% last quarter) despite a very weak overall analyst quality score (D+).
ranked_picks.rationale: Only 'forming' support — a barely-positive higher low and a down/up volume ratio still above 1 mean selling hasn't fully dried up, even though Last10d return is already positive; this is a high-beta (4.25), speculative name with genuinely strong news flow.
ranked_picks.bear_case: EPS misses have been extreme and consistent every quarter, the D+ overall analyst score reflects real balance-sheet/valuation concerns, and this is one of the most volatile names in the batch — a broader crypto/AI-infrastructure selloff could hit it hard regardless of contract wins.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: CleanSpark missed EPS estimates in each of its last 4 quarters, but just signed a $6.6B, 20-year AI/HPC data-center lease — a major real catalyst for its pivot beyond bitcoin mining — even as its overall analyst quality score remains weak (C-) and it's a heavily-shorted name.
ranked_picks.rationale: Support is 'forming' rather than confirmed (no positive higher low yet, though Last10d/Last20d returns are both already positive), and the data-center lease is a genuine catalyst, but persistent EPS misses and a weak analyst score keep this lower.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Consistent EPS misses and a weak overall quality score (C-) suggest real fundamental fragility beneath the infrastructure-pivot story, and heavy short interest adds volatility risk in either direction.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Smithfield Foods beat EPS estimates in 3 of its last 4 quarters with a record Q2, but revenue/net-income growth turned negative the last two quarters, and industry peer news (Chinese pork oversupply) points to sector headwinds. Analyst targets are flat (0% recent revision) with a solid Buy consensus.
ranked_picks.rationale: A barely-positive higher low (+0.11%) and only mild recent price weakness support a 'forming' read, but reward:risk is weak (1.34, flagged WeakRR), and negative recent revenue growth tempers the beat record.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Revenue and net income growth have turned negative the last two quarters, and the weak reward:risk means the trade offers little margin for error if the pullback resumes.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Urban Edge Properties beat EPS estimates in 3 of its last 4 quarters, but net income growth turned sharply negative last quarter (-20.9%) and there is no News coverage at all for this ticker — no catalyst, positive or negative, to point to.
ranked_picks.rationale: The pullback low was made today with no confirmed higher low yet, so support is only 'forming'; combined with weak reward:risk (2.8, flagged WeakRR) and zero news catalyst, this ranks near the bottom of the selected list.
ranked_picks.bear_case: There's no forward catalyst here at all, net income growth just declined, and with the low made today and no confirmed reversal yet, there's real risk the pullback isn't over.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: UL Solutions beat EPS estimates in all 8 of its last reported quarters with strong income growth, but the trade plan's reward:risk here is extremely weak (0.93:1, flagged WeakRR) — the geometry doesn't support the setup even though the fundamental record is excellent.
ranked_picks.rationale: Ranked last: despite a spotless beat record and a Cramer 'potential buy' mention, the trade plan's sub-1:1 reward:risk after support/resistance refinement means this doesn't clear the bar on setup quality even with a reasonably supportive technical picture.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Reward:risk here is worse than breakeven (0.93:1) — even a fundamentally sound company can produce a poor trade if the stop and target are this close together, and no higher low is confirmed yet (HigherLowPct 0.0).
